log.content: forEach
may lead to performance issues when working with large arrays. When combined with functions like
filter
or
map
, this causes multiple iterations over the same type.
Unsafe fix: Replace with optional chain operator
This operator includes runtime checks, so it is safer than the compile-only non-null assertion operator
